# Subway Seat for Hex list

Plain text, one color per line as #hex and its name. Most palette tools will take a paste of it.

[Hex list](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/palette/) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/txt/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.txt`](subway-seat.txt) | paste it wherever you need the colors |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.txt`](subway-seat-tunnel.txt) | paste it wherever you need the colors |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.txt`](subway-seat-enamel.txt) | paste it wherever you need the colors |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in a terminal: copy the hex codes, for Coolors, Figma plugins or anything that takes a paste:

```sh
cut -d' ' -f1 subway-seat.txt | pbcopy          # macOS
cut -d' ' -f1 subway-seat.txt | wl-copy         # Linux, Wayland
cut -d' ' -f1 subway-seat.txt | xclip -sel clip # Linux, X11
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in a terminal: copy the hex codes, for Coolors, Figma plugins or anything that takes a paste:

```sh
cut -d' ' -f1 subway-seat-tunnel.txt | pbcopy          # macOS
cut -d' ' -f1 subway-seat-tunnel.txt | wl-copy         # Linux, Wayland
cut -d' ' -f1 subway-seat-tunnel.txt | xclip -sel clip # Linux, X11
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in a terminal: copy the hex codes, for Coolors, Figma plugins or anything that takes a paste:

```sh
cut -d' ' -f1 subway-seat-enamel.txt | pbcopy          # macOS
cut -d' ' -f1 subway-seat-enamel.txt | wl-copy         # Linux, Wayland
cut -d' ' -f1 subway-seat-enamel.txt | xclip -sel clip # Linux, X11
```
